Read /tmp/fbc_res_plan.md and carry out exactly the task it specifies. It is a Lean 4 task where the hard mathematical work is DONE and verified in a probe file; your job is to lift a verified tactic chain into a named definition plus a reduction theorem in the real module, and make the project build clean.

Critical process notes:
- File your findings as you go. If you run low on budget, emit what you have IMMEDIATELY rather than stalling — a reviewer subagent in this same session died at 187 bytes having filed nothing. Your final message must contain the concrete results the plan asks for.
- Never introduce a `sorry`, and never weaken the statement being reduced.
- The build takes ~3 minutes. Run it in the foreground and actually wait for it; do not guess the outcome.
- Only edit AlgebraicJacobian/Cohomology/CechHigherDirectImageUnconditional.lean. Do not touch other files in the tree, and do not delete or force-add any probe_*.lean files.
